title: 2574. Left and Right Sum Differences

examples.explanation: The array leftSum is [0,10,14,22] and the array rightSum is [15,11,3,0]. The array answer is [|0 - 15|,|10 - 11|,|14 - 3|,|22 - 0|] = [15,1,11,22].
The array leftSum is [0] and the array rightSum is [0]. The array answer is [|0 - 0|] = [0].
